subsection.name: Description
subsection.div: Checks that throw statements within catch blocks do not use the caught exception's getMessage() call when the thrown exception is the same type as the caught exception, as rethrowing the same exception type with its own message is redundant.
subsection.p: Rationale: When throwing an exception of the same type as the caught exception and including the caught exception's message via getMessage(), the information is redundant. The original exception should be rethrown directly, or a different exception type should be used.

subsection.name: Violation Messages
subsection.p: All messages can be customized if the default message doesn't suit you. Please see the documentation to learn how to.

subsection.name: Fully Qualified Name
subsection.p: Use this fully qualified class name in configuration when an exact class reference is required.
